units.source_text: 莲花盛开之时，明石皇后举办法华八讲。

en.t: When the lotus flowers were in full bloom, Empress Akashi held the Eight Lectures on the Lotus Sutra.

units.source_text: 首先是为亡父六条院主，其次是为义母紫夫人。

en.t: First they were held for her late father, the Lord of Rokujo, and then for her foster mother, Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 各各分定日期，供养经佛。

en.t: Separate days were appointed for each, and offerings were made to the scriptures and the Buddha.

units.source_text: 这法会非常庄严盛大。

en.t: The service was exceptionally solemn and magnificent.

units.source_text: 讲第五卷的那一天，仪式尤为隆重，

en.t: On the day when the fifth scroll was expounded, the ceremony was especially grand,

units.source_text: 各处通过有亲戚关系之侍女到六条院来观光之人甚多。

en.t: and many people came from various places to Rokujo through waiting women with whom they had family connections, in order to watch.

units.source_text: 第五天朝座讲第八讲，功德圆满。

en.t: At the morning session on the fifth day, the eighth lecture was delivered, and the merit of the rite was brought to completion.

units.source_text: 这期间殿内暂作佛堂装饰，现在要恢复原状，

en.t: During this period the interior of the residence had temporarily been decorated as a Buddhist hall, and now it had to be restored to its former state,

units.source_text: 因此北厢中的纸隔扇也都打开，以便仆役等进去布置装修。

en.t: so the paper sliding screens in the northern eaves room were all opened to let the servants enter and rearrange the furnishings.

units.source_text: 这时候就请大公主暂住西面廊房中。

en.t: At this time the elder princess was asked to stay temporarily in the rooms along the western corridor.

units.source_text: 众侍女听讲疲倦了，各自回房中休息，

en.t: The waiting women had grown tired from listening to the lectures and each returned to her own room to rest,

units.source_text: 大公主身边侍女甚少。

en.t: so there were very few attendants beside the elder princess.

units.source_text: 薰大将因有要事必须与今天退出的法师中的一人商谈，

en.t: General Kaoru had an urgent matter that he needed to discuss with one of the priests who was leaving that day,

units.source_text: 便换了便袍走到钓殿里来找他。

en.t: so he changed into informal robes and went to the fishing pavilion to look for him.

units.source_text: 后来僧众全部退出，薰大将暂时坐在池塘旁边纳凉。

en.t: Afterward, when all the monks had withdrawn, General Kaoru sat for a while beside the pond to enjoy the cool air.

units.source_text: 此时人影稀少，

en.t: At that moment there were few people about,

units.source_text: 前述的小宰相君等在附近设置帷屏，隔成小室，暂在那里休息。

en.t: and the previously mentioned Lady Kozaisho and the others had set up screens nearby, partitioning off a small space where they were resting for the time being.

units.source_text: 薰大将想道：“小宰相君或恐就在这里，听到衣衫窸窣之声呢。”

en.t: General Kaoru thought, "Lady Kozaisho may well be here; I can hear the rustle of robes."

units.source_text: 便从中廊的纸隔扇的隙缝里窥探，

en.t: He then peered through a crack in the paper sliding screens of the middle corridor,

units.source_text: 但见里面不像普通侍女房间的样子，布置得非常清爽。

en.t: and saw that the interior did not look like an ordinary waiting woman's room; it was arranged in a very fresh and refined way.

units.source_text: 从参差的帷屏的隙间窥探，室内一目了然。

en.t: Peering through the gaps between the unevenly placed screens, he could see the whole room at a glance.
